name: 3D Volume Wavelet Preprocessing for 2D Slice Retrieval
aliases: 3D Wavelet Compression with Preprocessing for 2D Random Access
definition: A preprocessing scheme for 3D volume data that rearranges adjacent slices to enable faster decoding of individual 2D images from a 3D wavelet transform. It solves the problem of inefficient random access to 2D slices by ensuring each subband coefficient corresponds to a specific 2D image, reducing the number of coefficients that must be decoded.
summary: This compression scheme enables fast random access to 2D slices by preprocessing 3D data to isolate coefficients, reducing decoding time by up to 2x compared to standard wavelet coding.
